column1: [User Security] What sensitive user information is stored exclusively in the /etc/shadow file, and what are its access permissions?
column2: Hashed account passwords and password aging/expiration parameters; it is readable only by the root user and members of the shadow group.

[Account Management] Which command with flags allows safe editing of the /etc/shadow file with syntax verification?

[User Provisioning] What is the purpose of the /etc/skel directory during new user creation?
column2: It contains template files and directories (such as default dotfiles) that are automatically copied into a newly created user's home directory.

column1: [Password Security] In output from chage -l, what does "inactive" password status mean during a grace period?
column2: The number of days after a password expires during which the user can still log in and change their password before the account is fully locked. (Grace period)
